//: Per-page allowances for Tools/a11y-sweep/test/smoke-a11y-sweep.mjs, the site-wide axe-core pass.
Each entry names a page (as listed in the sweep's output), the axe rule id it is allowed to
fail, and a reason. An allowed rule that no longer fires on that page makes the run red, the
same way suites.json's expectedFailures cannot outlive the bug: fix the page, remove the entry.
Never add an entry to silence a new finding without a reason that names where the fix belongs.
